notes: Malphite is a tank with low sustained dueling damage whose whole threat is Unstoppable Force, so the fight score weights level 6 heavily but keeps level, item and gold leads smaller than for a duelist: a Malphite a level up still can't out-trade most bruisers. Before 6 ranged tops kite him and he can't kill tanks, so those lanes lean toward Q-poke-and-farm; after 6 his R answers ranged champions and Ground Slam cripples auto-attackers. After laning he does not split and duel: he pushes a side wave only when ahead or before an objective, then groups, sets up objectives, looks for a multi-target R and holds it to counter-engage when his team is behind.

Clean waves, full shield, big ult. Let's go.
